notes: IonQ announced March 11, 2026 landmark agreement with University of Cambridge to deploy 6th-generation chip-based 256-qubit trapped-ion system at Cavendish Laboratory. Will be UK's most powerful quantum computer. Part of IonQ Quantum Innovation Centre. Builds on IonQ Tempo's 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity world record. Deployment timeline not specified. Focus areas: quantum hardware, networking, sensing, security.
